crossRefs.note: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent…
The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan…
So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: But the people there refused to welcome Him, because He was heading for Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he were going to Jerusalem.
